snippet.title: Fallout: Long 15 -  Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Long 15 – NCR Expansion is a brand-new Fallout: New Vegas mod that brings players deep into NCR territory, crossing the border through the Long 15 and into the heart of California.

Explore a massive new worldspace filled with quests, factions, towns, conflicts, and secrets. Shape the Mojave-California frontier as it reaches its breaking point.

Download Long 15 – NCR Expansion: https://www.nexusmods.com/newvegas/mods/94306 

Want updates, previews, or to get involved? Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mwbNAXXm9U

Long 15 Development Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/TheLong15/

Edited & Recorded by: iro https://www.youtube.com/@irolol using the Hikikomori NVR preset (https://www.nexusmods.com/newvegas/mods/93406)

Featuring Voice Acting by:
N7Merk (Colonel Royez)
Jeremy Tucker (Frederick Stanton)
Irakli Chkhikvadze (Morton Stone)
Sean Cresse (Roberto)
Ray "Dub" Russell (Bunker Bob)
Alexandria Morris (Rushing Waters)

Music: “Burn the Witch” – Shawn James
Courtesy of Shawn James Music Inc.

Thanks so much for watching - and welcome to the Long 15!
